This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellant/Insurance Company impugning the judgment and award dated 16.12.2023 passed by the learned Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Sonitpur, Tezpur in MAC Case No. 86/2022 whereby the appellant was directed to pay a compensation amount of Rs.14,43,000/- along with 7.5% interest per annum to the to the claimants respondents.
